player_prompt.intro:
Uri Player {player_id} mumatchi wa GameOfPureStrategy.
- Uri ine ma 13 cards A-K; zvinogona kushandiswa kana zvirimo.
- Mumwaka wekutanga karenda yeprize inotangwa. Ita karenda imwe chete inosanganisira token yakabatwa kama '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kadi inopfuura inowina prize (pamoja nechikwata). Mashoko kuwana karenda inenge ichibva kwenye choto kwa raundi inotevera.
- Jumla yakareba inowina raundi 13.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action must contain exactly ONE bracketed card token.
